project_type: Static GitHub Pages site + Node 24 ESM data pipeline (no framework, no server, no database). Repo c:\Users\sudiskmr\Downloads\DomainClassification\ahead, branch main, remote GitHub Sudish007/ahead. Work directly in this checkout; there is no worktree.
language: JavaScript (ESM). src/*.js pipeline modules, scripts/*.mjs CLIs, tests/*.test.js with node:test + node:assert/strict.
build_system: No build step. package.json scripts: test = node --test "tests/**/*.test.js"; fetch = node scripts/fetch.mjs; probe = node scripts/probe-sources.mjs; serve = node scripts/serve.mjs. One dependency, fast-xml-parser 5.11.2 (exact pin). Node v24.16.0 locally; actions/setup-node@v7 node 24 on ubuntu-latest.
test_framework: node:test, 177 tests in 20 files, fully offline: tests/helpers.js fixtureFetch() maps every registry URL to tests/fixtures/* and THROWS on any unmapped URL; overrides = { [url]: { status, body, contentType, throw } } force failures. tests/http.test.js uses a fakeClock() whose sleep() advances time (see its retry-matrix test). NOW = 2026-10-19T12:00:00Z in every date-dependent test.
test_command: npm test   (about 45 s; must stay 0 fail). Live network check that writes nothing: node scripts/fetch.mjs --dry-run --no-llm (full registry) or node scripts/fetch.mjs --source yt-karpathy,importai --dry-run.
verification_instructions: 1) npm test green. 2) node scripts/fetch.mjs --dry-run --no-llm exits 0 (local machine gets 200 from every source; it does NOT reproduce the runner problem). 3) RUNNER-ONLY checks: git pull --rebase origin main (the bot commits data/ back to main after every run, so origin/main is usually ahead), git push origin HEAD:main (a push to main that touches anything outside data/ triggers .github/workflows/refresh.yml), then gh run list --workflow refresh.yml --limit 3 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,createdAt ; gh run watch <id> --exit-status ; gh run view <id> --log (the fetch step is named 'Fetch sources and build the brief'; runSource warn lines look like 'importai: HTTP 403' and the per-source table follows). Manual dispatch: gh workflow run refresh.yml  (after FEAT-001 also: gh workflow run refresh.yml -f probe=true). After the run: git pull --rebase origin main and read data/meta.json (per-source status/httpStatus/error/note/detail). Live copy: https://sudish007.github.io/ahead/data/meta.json. The 03:42:54Z baseline is 33 ok / 19 empty / 12 failed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: data/items.json, data/meta.json, data/digests/*.json are generated by the Actions bot and committed to main with [skip ci]; never hand-edit them and never commit a local live run's data/ (use --dry-run locally). After each Actions run, git pull --rebase origin main before pushing again.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell locally (use Select-String, not grep, when reading gh logs). gh CLI is authenticated as Sudish007. Pushing to main is REQUIRED for this task (it is the only way to test on the runner) but only after npm test is green and the dry run exits 0; the live site must keep working after every push. Never git add -A; add files by name; never commit data/ or .agents/ from a coder step. Do not add API keys, proxies, Invidious/Piped mirrors, or third-party scraping services. validateMeta in src/schema.js caps meta.sources[id].error at 120 chars, no newline; error is shown in the UI health list (app.js line 183). concurrency group 'refresh' queues runs; a push run plus a dispatch run both complete, each commits data/.
contribution_requirements: Follow .agents/tasks/ahead-build/plan.md conventions: ESM, node:test, no console.* inside src/ except pipeline.js defaultLogger (tests/pipeline.test.js counts exactly 3 console uses in pipeline.js and 0 elsewhere), run() never writes stdout, exact-pinned deps, flat tests in tests/*.test.js. Conventional-commit messages (feat:, fix:, docs:, ci:). README.md documents every user-visible command/limit.
key_patterns: src/http.js createHttpClient({ fetchImpl, githubToken, sleep, nowMs, userAgent }).fetchText(url, { timeoutMs=20000, maxBytes, accept, deadlineAt }) -> { status, text, finalUrl, contentType }; headersFor(url, accept) builds request headers (currently Ahead/<version> UA + ACCEPT.feed; api.github.com gets Bearer token + vnd.github+json); once() follows redirects manually (MAX_REDIRECTS 5) and throws HttpError(status, url, retryAfter) on >= 400 after cancelling the body; retryable(err, host) + a single 2 s retry in fetchText, skipped when deadlineAt - nowMs() < 25_000; errorClass(err) -> 'HTTP 403' | 'timeout' | 'network' | ... . src/pipeline.js runSource(source, deps) wraps fetch+parse in a 45 s backstop and records { status, fetched, kept, ms, httpStatus, note, error }; run() builds meta.sources[id] from those entries ({ id, ...rest } spread, so new fields flow through) and calls validateMeta. src/parsers/arxiv.js fetchArxivSource: RSS primary, export.arxiv.org API fallback via fetchApi(); empty RSS + failed fallback -> status 'empty', note 'api fallback failed'. scripts/fetch.mjs printTable prints 'id | status | fetched | kept | ms | note/error'. tests/helpers.js fixtureFetch identifies sitemap PAGE fetches by /text\/html/.test(accept) (line 124) and tests/pipeline.test.js line 145 does the same; both must become accept.startsWith('text/html') once ACCEPT.feed contains text/html;q=0.8. tests/sitemap.test.js pins page-fetch accept === 'text/html' (keep ACCEPT.html unchanged).
directory_structure: src/ pipeline modules (http.js, pipeline.js, schema.js, registry.js, normalize.js, dedup.js, score.js, brief.js, llm.js, parsers/{feed,arxiv,json,reddit,sitemap,common}.js); scripts/ CLIs (fetch.mjs, probe-sources.mjs, serve.mjs); tests/ node:test files + tests/fixtures/ (31 captured feeds) + tests/helpers.js; data/ bot-generated JSON (committed by Actions); index.html app.js styles.css favicon.svg frontend; .github/workflows/refresh.yml the 6-hourly refresh + Pages deploy; .agents/tasks/ahead-build/ planning/verification docs (tracked).
